---
title: "Robustness Check: Preregistered Models"
output: html_document
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
---

The primary analyses use a cubic term for `depression_sum`, chosen in `Main Analysis.Rmd` section 1.5. This check refits the primary models as preregistered: with a linear term, and with the preregistered symptom x date interaction (prereg section 7). It compares predictions and risk ratios with the primary models.

```{r setup, message = F, warning = F}
library(here)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(mice)
library(marginaleffects)
library(tidyverse)
`%+%` <- paste0

source(here("Helper Functions", "Analysis Functions.R"))

pimh_c <- readRDS(here("Data", "PIMH - 2012-2019", "pimh_completed.rds"))
pih_c <- readRDS(here("Data", "PIH - 2019-Current", "pih_completed.rds"))
all_c <- readRDS(here("Data", "PIMH + PIH Combined", "all_completed.rds"))
```

```{r fit}
covariates <- " + age + race_recoded + gender + education"

specifications <- tribble(
  ~dataset,   ~data,  ~years,       ~extra,
  "PIMH",     pimh_c, c(2016, 2019), "",
  "PIH",      pih_c,  c(2019, 2026), "",
  "Combined", all_c,  c(2016, 2026), " + dataset"
)

models <- c(
  "Preregistered (linear)" = "depression_sum + decimal_year_centered",
  "Preregistered (linear, with interaction)" = "depression_sum * decimal_year_centered",
  "Primary (cubic)" = "poly(depression_sum, 3) + decimal_year_centered"
)

# Fit one model and keep only its pooled coefficients, predictions, and risk ratios (fitted models are not kept, to save memory)
summarize_fit <- function(data, formula, years) {
  fit <- fit_models(data, as.formula(formula))
  tibble(
    coefficients = list(summary(pool(fit), conf.int = T) %>% select(term, estimate, std.error, p.value, conf.low = `2.5 %`, conf.high = `97.5 %`)),
    predictions = list(as_tibble(point_predictions(fit, years))),
    ratios = list(as_tibble(risk_ratios(fit)))
  )
}

results <- specifications %>%
  expand_grid(model = names(models)) %>%
  mutate(
    formula = "dep_self_label_now ~ " %+% models[model] %+% covariates %+% extra,
    summaries = pmap(list(data, formula, years), summarize_fit)
  ) %>%
  select(-data) %>%
  unnest(summaries)
```

## Preregistered Symptom x Date Interaction (Log-Odds)

```{r interaction}
results %>%
  filter(model == "Preregistered (linear, with interaction)") %>%
  select(dataset, coefficients) %>%
  unnest(coefficients) %>%
  filter(term == "depression_sum:decimal_year_centered") %>%
  kable(digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling()
```

## Coefficients, Preregistered Models Without Interaction (Log-Odds)

```{r coefficients}
results %>%
  filter(model == "Preregistered (linear)") %>%
  select(dataset, coefficients) %>%
  unnest(coefficients) %>%
  kable(digits = 3) %>%
  kable_styling()
```

## Risk Ratios per Year

```{r ratios}
results %>%
  select(dataset, model, ratios) %>%
  unnest(ratios) %>%
  select(dataset, model, depression_sum, estimate, conf.low, conf.high) %>%
  kable(digits = 3) %>%
  kable_styling()
```

## Point Predictions

```{r predictions}
results %>%
  select(dataset, model, predictions) %>%
  unnest(predictions) %>%
  transmute(dataset, model, depression_sum, year = decimal_year_centered + 2021, estimate, conf.low, conf.high) %>%
  kable(digits = 3) %>%
  kable_styling()
```
